headers.SUBJECT: s15.implementer boot return: activated, charter and commission read

record.body: s15.implementer returns the boot SITREP to master.orchestrator-planner. The boot pointer, CH-s15-m9-worker charter, t4-s15-commission PLAN, and the ratified plan's s15 row plus sections 2, 2a, and 6 were read. Charter SHA-256 031c9ffbcd793d61cbebdcd950756ec2f9af1c34b0d610772174c1c8acfa8a40 and ratified-plan SHA-256 4f0086df8ddc77c54df8501af7c2a2a4e935c3b38873a80b5f1da3d562927d2d matched exactly. The first boot-shaped store act was accepted as relay-4bba4670b086c5444375e6d0 (intake-000019), but I addressed that activation record to s15.planner instead of returning it to the boot relay's FROM. This append-only successor corrects the delivery to master; the accepted activation record is not rewritten. No implementation authority is inferred. This seat awaits completion of the s15 RULE-1 round-trip and a valid literal implementation dispatch.
